Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, provided brief information regarding the conduct of the meeting.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the Wall That Heals will be
open to visitors from March 23­26, 2023; and that a pet vaccination clinic will be held on March 18,
2023.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a Neighborhood Safety Meeting will be held on
March 1, 2023 at 6:00pm.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, announced that today is the end of the state’s COVID­19 State of
Emergency.

There were no City Council Reports.
